title: Heavy Metal Contamination in Environmental Compartments of Buriganga River in Dhaka City
authors: Md. Isreq Hossen Real, Asef Redwan, Md. Mosheur Rahman Shourov, Hossain Azam, Nehreen Majed
abstract: This book chapter evaluates the partitioning of heavy metals (Cd, Cr, Pb, Ni, Zn) across sediment, surface water, aquatic macrophytes (Enhydra fluctuans), and fish in Buriganga River. Cr and Pb exceeded surface water criteria for aquatic life protection, and alarming concentrations were recorded in sediment adjacent to historical tannery and industrial effluent channels in Dhaka.
